verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM has a dedicated first-party docs section, "MCP Compatibility in AnythingLLM", which indicates it can use MCP servers within its agent framework. However, the pack shows only the page title. The probe labels the page as documenting an 'official MCP server', so whether it acts as client or server is not stated in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented steps for adding or configuring MCP servers, supported transports (stdio/SSE/HTTP), confirmation that agents invoke MCP tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
